title: Covered-long-term-gain eligible transaction proceeds (scalar collectible companion), tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every proceeds amount of a covered, long-term, gain-only Form 1099-B transaction admitted to tax.us.2025.f1099b.covered-ltcg is recorded as its scalar proceeds companion, at the same identity, as of the keyed horizon (ADR-0054 Decision 2). This claim covers only column (d)'s collectible source; it says nothing about basis, gain, the object family's own closure, or Schedule D completeness.
